newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks slow advance amid profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks slow advance amid profit-taking.

text.p: Mexican stocks ceded some earlier gains by midafternoon Thursday amid profit-taking, but the market was still solidly higher, traders said.
The leading IPC share index was holding above the important 4,600-point psychological barrier, with U.S. stocks on Wall Street staging another powerful advance.
"There's a little profit-taking. The market was a bit frothy. The market feels firm, but I personally would call rather than raise the stakes right now," a floor trader said.
The IPC was up 44.04, or 0.97 percent, at 4,603.97, down from a record high of 4,622.41 reached earlier in the day.
Trading volume was brisk at 89.7 million shares.
On the broad market, gainers were outpacing decliners 70 to 23, with other 110 stocks changing hands.
"The Dow is also soaring like crazy. The way things are you have to throw all your cash into the market," another trader said.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average closed 100.43 points higher at 7,895.81 in shortened session ahead of a three-day holiday weekend in the United States.
